name: Anthelion
author: Erin Carter
description: Named for the mirrored counter-sun halo — the luminous, higher-key end of the family. A blazing multi-hue core throws a corona of mirror-folded rays of uneven length, long spikes between short ones like a real sun corona, crossed by a finer counter-rotating spark fan and ringed by concentric arcs broken into glowing beads. Pure bent light rather than cut glass, radiant on a deep dusk-blue sky.

params.label: Rays
params.effect: Number of light spokes (mirror-fold count, floored in-shader).

params.label: Halo speed
params.effect: Speed the concentric halo rings bloom outward; at 0 the arcs hold their radii.

params.label: Spin
params.effect: Rotation speed of the whole ray fan.

params.label: Glow
params.effect: Overall luminosity of rays, haloes and core.
